desc: Ideation: LCM-per-subset cost + subset DP approach validated
Implement cost[mask] for all non-empty masks: lcm via math.gcd loop; cost[mask] = min over nums of (-x) % lcm
Implement subset DP: dp[mask] = min over non-empty submask s of mask: dp[mask ^ s] + cost[s]; dp[0] = 0
Return dp[(1<<k)-1] and wrap in starter code with imports (math, typing.List)
Test against the three examples, plus edge cases: duplicate targets, nums element already multiple, single target
